text:
Situation: Bacteriostatic water has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-12-03 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 40 units (11.3 days); Corvale General holds 83 units (19.5 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2021-12-03. Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) received an OAI classification letter dated 2020-05-25, 557 days before the posting. Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) received an OAI classification letter dated 2020-04-22, 590 days before the posting. Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) received a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12 and multiple OAI inspections in 2010 and 2011.

Our position: Current inventory covers less than three weeks at both sites. The rule‑based best option is purchasing from Fujian Genohope Biotech Ltd., which is not on FDA's shortage list today. A secondary option is a protocol change to Sterile Water 1 mL/mL from Nephron Pharmaceuticals Corporation, approved 2026-07-09.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer initiates purchase from Fujian Genohope Biotech Ltd.; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Treating prescriber evaluates protocol change to Nephron Sterile Water 1 mL/mL with pharmacist verification; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement or protocol review while inventory falls below seven days at either site.
